findings.evidence: Line 106-107: `P.IsGeneratingTriple s.1 ↔ s.1.monodromyGroup = P.G ∧ HasPassport s P`. Naming conventions name both conjuncts of an iff RHS, cf. `lt_iff_le_not_ge : a < b ↔ a ≤ b ∧ ¬b ≤ a` in the conventions document.
findings.fix: Rename to `isGeneratingTriple_iff_monodromyGroup_eq_and_hasPassport` (or state the monodromy condition as a hypothesis and keep `isGeneratingTriple_iff_hasPassport_of_monodromyGroup_eq`).
findings.issue: `isGeneratingTriple_iff_hasPassport` advertises `IsGeneratingTriple t ↔ HasPassport t P`, but the proved right-hand side is the conjunction `s.1.monodromyGroup = P.G ∧ HasPassport s P`. The name names only one of the two conjuncts, so it claims an equivalence strictly stronger than the statement (being in the passport does not make a triple a generating triple).

findings.evidence: Mathlib uses the `_apply_coe` suffix for exactly this shape: `IntermediateField.intermediateFieldMap_apply_coe` (Mathlib/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Basic.lean:524), `iccHomeoI_apply_coe` (Mathlib/Topology/UnitInterval.lean:550); the repo itself uses `coe_equivFiniteCodimensionOneCycles_apply` (TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/WeilDivisor/Scheme/Basic.lean:233).
findings.issue: `generatingTripleOrbitsEquivClasses_apply_mk` states the equality of the *coercions* out of the subtype (`(e (Quotient.mk'' g) : ConnectedIsoClass n) = g.toClass hn hG`), not of the equiv's values; the name promises the latter and no such lemma exists.

findings.evidence: Lines 141-143: hypotheses `(ht : P.IsGeneratingTriple t) (hτt : P.IsGeneratingTriple (τ • t))`; conventions: "to disambiguate the name of theorem or better convey the intended reference, it is necessary to describe some of the hypotheses" after `of`.
findings.issue: `mem_normalizer_of_smul` names no hypothesis that actually holds: the conclusion follows from `P.IsGeneratingTriple t` and `P.IsGeneratingTriple (τ • t)`, not from τ being a scalar action. As a top-level `PassportSpec` name (and an advertised main declaration) it gives no clue the lemma is about generating triples, unlike its sibling `exists_isGeneratingTriple_smul`.

summary: Names are mostly conclusion-describing and the namespacing (TauCeti.PassportSpec / PassportSpec.GeneratingTriple) and absence of notation are fine, but one iff-name drops a conjunct of its own right-hand side, one equiv lemma name omits the coercion it actually states, and one main declaration's name fails to identify its hypotheses.
